ctx.x: Tubby was - call him a cabaret drummer. You call Tubby and Zuffy - they're cabaret drummers. They couldn't play the whole bit because they wasn't thinking in terms of the whole bit. The only two drummers that were in Chicago was naturally Jimmy Bertrand, He could do the whole bit, Jimmy Bertrand or even Walter Bishop would have to go down to rehearse to show the white drummers how to play, but they

weren't allowed to perform. You know what I mean; it just didn't go on like that. The only people that can tell you these things - I'm pretty sure Mr. Lou Singer is alive - you know, Lou Singer played the Oriental, he played the State and Lake.
